title: Tokamak plasma control with reinforcement learning
summary: A single neural network controls the magnetic coils of Lausanne’s TCV tokamak and forms plasmas in different configurations (snowflake, ITER-like shape, double droplet). Trained mainly in simulation and then tested on the real machine. Stated limitations: plasma lasts about three seconds and the machine changes from day to day.
organization: Google DeepMind and EPFL Swiss Plasma Center
